summary: A free, professional-grade weather radar for **Windows, Android and Debian Linux**. Radar data comes straight from NOAA's open data, and every calculation happens on your device.
highlights: **Full NEXRAD Level 2**, every moment and every tilt, plus Level 3 and the national MRMS mosaic
**3D storm volumes** you can fly through, with terrain and hydrometeor classification
Warnings, SPC outlooks, lightning, soundings, and replay back to 1991
**Addons** for custom radar sites, overlays, places and themes
lede: A free, open, professional-grade weather radar. **No subscription. No accounts. No servers.** Radar data comes straight from NOAA's open data, and every calculation happens on your device.

features.title: Radar data
items: **Full NEXRAD Level 2**: REF, VEL, SW, ZDR, PHI, RHO at every elevation cut, super-resolution
All the common **Level 3** products with tilt selection
The national **MRMS mosaic** takes over when you zoom out
Sharp at any zoom: redrawn at screen resolution, never stretched

features.title: Derived products
items: Composite reflectivity, VIL, echo tops
Storm-relative velocity and rotation (azimuthal shear)

features.title: 3D
items: GPU-raymarched storm volumes you can **fly through**
Slice planes, optional **3D terrain**, cone of silence
Reflectivity, storm-relative and ground-relative wind, ZDR and CC fields
**Hydrometeor classification**: rain, hail, graupel, snow and more, each class its own switch

features.title: Situational awareness
items: Live NWS **warnings, watches and advisories**, tap for the full text
SPC convective outlook and today's storm reports
**Upper-air soundings** with CAPE, CIN, shear and helicity
Lightning from Blitzortung, GOES GLM, or both

features.title: Tools
items: **Aiming cursor**: exact value, range, heading and beam height
**Historical replay** back to 1991, 3D included
Distance and bearing, PNG snapshots of 2D and 3D
`.pal` colour tables and four basemaps

features.title: Addons
items: Your own **radar sites**, from S3, a web folder or a local folder
An **open radar format** for any radar your own converter reads
GeoJSON and tile **overlays**, **places** with beam height, and **themes**
